about the five negative thinking
patterns that are destroying your
confidence imagine for a second that
there's a business that you've been
meaning to start for the longest time
and you've spent a lot of your time and
energy and effort into making this
business work now unfortunately for
whatever reason the business fails and
it fails miserably what are the thoughts
that you will have following the
collapse of that business you might have
thought something on the lines of I am
never going to be able to you know run a
successful company it's all my fault I
shouldn't have taken those extra 2 weeks
of vacation I shouldn't have brought
that expensive laptop or all these
different thought patterns now these
patterns of thinking these negative
patterns of thinking are based on
pre-attentive constructions of reality
which in simpler words is faulty
thinking now pre-attentive constructions
of reality is a subconscious process of
thinking where we start to think or make
automatic thought responses even before
we have consciously processed that
information now because the speed of
this type of thinking is so high there's
a lot of chances of cognitive biases and
errors examples of automatic thinking is
games like spot the color you might have
played these games as kids with your
friends where you guys would just go
around and somebody says spot the color

as possible phrases like you're going to

overgeneralizing overgeneralizing

monologues can sound like I'm never
going to be able to run a successful
company ever again the underlying
presumption being that if it is true in
one situation it's going to be true for
any other situation that even remotely
looks similar now the second type of
faulty thinking or negative thinking
pattern is called selective abstraction
now selective abstraction in your head
can sound like all I can think about is
this failure there is nothing else to my
life and the underlying assumption being
that I can only hyperfocus in the
failures I can only hyperfocus on the
failures and nothing else and there is

type of negative thinking pattern is
excessive
responsibility internal monologue when

shouldn't have taken those two extra
vacations I shouldn't have bought that
expensive laptop the underlying
assumption being underneath excessive
responsibility that all bad things that

at the periphery of you and you are at

dichotomous thinking dichotomous
thinking in your head can sound like it
is all hopeless and there is absolutely
nothing that I can save from my business
the underlying assumption behind this
type of thinking is a very black and
white thinking it's a very extreme type
of thinking it is a very binary thinking
very good and bad type of thinking now
the main issue with these patterns of
negative thinking is that you
completely disregard the nuances of life
and the nuances of The Human Condition
by resorting to these types of or these
patterns of thinking you absolutely fail
to give yourself the grace for Being
Human now how do we solve this how do we

engage in these types of thinking the
more it slowly and surely steadily
starts to erode your confidence away and
you want to put a stop to that so
anytime the next time that you start to

question that you ask yourself is that
what is the evidence that what I'm

question that you ask yourself is what
